description: Canonical capability and anti-pattern relationships for the evidence-resolution maturity model. Pairing is explicit and must never be inferred from matching identifiers.

pairs.rationale: Enforced allocation tagging directly counters missing and inconsistent tags.
Accepted showback or chargeback strongly reduces black-box spend, while visibility may also exist without formal allocation.
Timely automated anomaly detection directly counters delayed cost reporting and discovery.
Unified cost dashboards strongly counter siloed views, although reporting can remain fragmented outside the dashboard surface.
Governed unit economics strongly counters vanity metrics, but either condition can be partially present independently.
Evidence-based commitment management directly counters systematic commitment avoidance.
Operational right-sizing directly counters chronic over-provisioning.
Governed waste elimination directly counters resource hoarding and zombie resources.
An automated spot strategy is strong optimization evidence against manual-only practices, but does not cover every optimization workflow.
Storage lifecycle discipline and discount-stacking awareness are separate optimization controls with only domain-level contextual corroboration.
A financial policy framework strongly constrains shadow accounts, while account enforcement also depends on identity and platform governance.
Governed budgeting and forecasting directly counters tolerance of repeated budget blowouts.
An empowered operating model strongly counters process-only FinOps theater, but effectiveness also requires demonstrated outcomes.
Active procurement and vendor management directly counters unexamined vendor lock-in.
Integrated compliance cost controls directly counter treating compliance cost as an afterthought.
Cost-aware architecture decisions directly counter unoptimized lift-and-shift delivery.
Infrastructure-as-code cost guardrails strongly constrain cost-blind architecture but do not replace design-time economic decisions.
Bounded automated scaling directly counters scaling without limits.
Evidence-based multi-cloud and hybrid management directly counters single-cloud tunnel vision.
Appropriate container and serverless optimization directly counters persistent monolith tax.
A cross-functional FinOps team strongly counters treating cost as only IT's problem, but participation must also extend beyond the team.
Enabled engineering accountability directly counters blame-based cost management.
Active executive sponsorship directly counters FinOps lip service.
Sustained cross-functional collaboration directly counters the finance-engineering wall.
Measured continuous improvement directly counters a static maturity assumption.
Token and model spend visibility directly counters invisible token spend.
AI allocation and unit economics strongly expose playground-to-production cost drift, while lifecycle controls are also required.
Governed model routing and prompt efficiency directly counters premium-model overuse.
AI budget guardrails strongly constrain unbounded context growth, while technical context controls remain independently necessary.
Measured AI value realization and governance directly counters AI value theater.
